nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a finite matroid on the ground set $E$ with rank function $r$ and characteristic polynomial $\chi_M(\lambda) = \sum_{I \subseteq E} (-1)^{|I|} \lambda^{r(E) - r(I)}$. For a natural number $k$, $w_k(M)$ is the absolute value of the coefficient of $\lambda^{r(E) - k}$ in $\chi_M$ when $k \le r(E)$, and $w_k(M) = 0$ when $k > r(E)$.
nodes.title: Absolute coefficients of the characteristic polynomial of a matroid

nodes.summary: Let $M$ be a finite matroid on the ground set $E$ with rank function $r$, and let $\chi_M(\lambda) = \sum_{I \subseteq E} (-1)^{|I|} \lambda^{r(E) - r(I)}$ be its characteristic polynomial. For a natural number $j$, this is the integer coefficient of $\lambda^j$ in $\chi_M$, that is, the sum of $(-1)^{|I|}$ over the subsets $I \subseteq E$ with $r(E) - r(I) = j$.
nodes.title: Coefficients of the characteristic polynomial of a matroid

nodes.summary: For every finite matroid $M$ on a ground set $E$ with rank function $r$, let $w_k(M)$ be the absolute value of the coefficient of $\lambda^{r(E) - k}$ in the characteristic polynomial $\chi_M(\lambda) = \sum_{I \subseteq E} (-1)^{|I|} \lambda^{r(E) - r(I)}$ when $k \le r(E)$, and $w_k(M) = 0$ when $k > r(E)$. Then $w_{k-1}(M) \, w_{k+1}(M) \le w_k(M)^2$ for every natural number $k \ge 1$.
nodes.title: Adiprasito–Huh–Katz theorem (Heron–Rota–Welsh conjecture)

nodes.summary: For every finite matroid $M$ on a ground set $E$ with rank function $r$, let $w_k(M)$ be the absolute value of the coefficient of $\lambda^{r(E) - k}$ in the characteristic polynomial $\chi_M(\lambda) = \sum_{I \subseteq E} (-1)^{|I|} \lambda^{r(E) - r(I)}$ when $k \le r(E)$, and $w_k(M) = 0$ when $k > r(E)$. Then $w_{k-1}(M) \, w_{k+1}(M) \le w_k(M)^2$ for every natural number $k \ge 1$.
nodes.title: Log-concavity of the characteristic polynomial of a matroid, statement

nodes.summary: For a matroid $M$ and a set $X$, this is the rank $r(X)$ of $X$ in $M$, the size of a largest independent set of $M$ contained in $X$, taken as a natural number; it is $0$ when this rank is infinite.
nodes.title: Rank of a set in a matroid, as a natural number

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved

stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
